## Part II:
```{r}
communities <- read_html("https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Community_areas_of_Chicago")
```
Reads the page into r

```{r}
df_communities <- communities %>%
  html_element("table") %>%
  html_table%>%
  janitor::clean_names()
```
Calls the table from the datapage and uses the element function to scrape the table from the page into a neat table

```{r}
df_communities <- df_communities %>%
  slice(-(1), -(n()))

df_communities <- df_communities %>%
  rename(
    area_sqmi = area_9,
    area_km = area_9_2,
    density_sqmi = density,
    density_km = density_2
  )

df_communities$population <- gsub("[,]","", df_communities$population)
df_communities$population <-as.numeric(df_communities$population)
```
Cleans the dataframe by cleaning the column names, removing additional rows and removing the commas from population in order to change population data type to numeric 

```{r}
print(df_communities[df_communities$no == 24, ])
```
Prints the row for west town
```{r}
print(head(df_communities[order(df_communities$population, decreasing = TRUE), ], 5))
```
Prints the top 5 most populated areas in Chicago

```{r}
url <- read_html("https://books.toscrape.com/")
```
Reads the link in r
```{r}
books <- url %>%
  html_elements(".product_pod")
```
Sections where information is located
```{r}
titles <- books %>%
  html_elements("h3 a") %>%
  html_attr("title")
titles
```
Pulls the title names into a list
```{r}
price <- books%>%
  html_elements(".price_color")%>%
  html_text2()
price
```
Pulls the price of the books into a list
```{r}

availability <- books %>%
  html_elements(".availability.instock")%>%
  html_text2()
availability
```
Pulls the avaliability of the book into a list
```{r}
books_20 <- tibble(
  title = titles,
  price = price,
  availability = availability
)
books_20
```
pulls all the elements into a table
```{r}
rating <- books %>%
  html_elements(".star-rating")%>%
  html_attr("class")

rating <- gsub("star-rating", "", rating)
rating

```
Add in rating column as a bonus 

```{r}
rating_num <- c(" One" = 1, " Two" = 2, " Three" = 3, " Four" = 4, " Five" = 5)

rating <- as.numeric(rating_num[rating])
rating
```
Had to create a vector so the written numbers could know which numeric values they belonged to and assign them

```{r}
books_20_bonus <- tibble(
  title = titles,
  price = price,
  availability = availability, 
  rating = rating
)
books_20_bonus
```
Final bonus table

## Part III

```{r}
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
```
Loads the needed libraries
```{r}
url <- "https://data.cityofchicago.org/resource/v6vf-nfxy.json"

params <- list(
    community_area = "24",
    '$where' = "created_date >= '2026-01-01T00:00:00'",
    '$order' = "created_date DESC",
    '$limit' = 1000
    )

response <- GET(url, query = params)
```
Requests the data from the url and put parameters around certain variables, like filtering

```{r}
df <- fromJSON(content(response, "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))

print(nrow(df))
```
```{r}
print(colnames(df))
```
Creates the dataframe from the information and prints the number of rows of the dataframe as well as the column names
